title: Project Preserve Destiny code name Staunch 118
plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says the NSA brought him in to communicate with aliens. He says this was done through a programme called Project Preserve Destiny, with training at an NSA site in Maryland in 1991, and that his code name in it was "Staunch 118." Sherman tells Michels this from his own experience. If true, it would mean a US intelligence agency was running a secret effort to talk with non-human beings.
